lines.zh: 我踩着枯针走，雪被爪尖翻起。
lines.en: I walk the dead needles, snow turning under my claws.

lines.zh: 我在黑松之间穿行，毛色贴着树皮。
lines.en: I move between the black pines, my coat matching the bark.

lines.zh: 我压低身子快走，雪面只留浅痕。
lines.en: I run low, leaving only shallow marks in the snow.

lines.zh: 我沿着林缘走，鼻尖贴着霜。
lines.en: I follow the treeline, my nose to the frost.
Every step lands solid.

lines.zh: 我绕过一丛冻住的灌木。
lines.en: I go around a frozen thicket.

lines.zh: 我走过一段结了霜的坡。
lines.en: I cross a frost-bound slope.
I stop, ears turning to the shadow.

lines.zh: 我转身时把雪扫成一道弧。
lines.en: Turning, I sweep the snow into an arc.
I walk on the side away from the light.

lines.zh: 我迈过一根断枝，没有碰它。
lines.en: I step over a broken branch without touching it.

lines.zh: 我从雾里走进来，又走进去。
lines.en: I come out of the mist and walk back into it.
I crack thin ice underfoot.

lines.zh: 我在树的间隔里找出一条线。
lines.en: I find a line between the trees.

lines.zh: 我伏在雪上，眼里的光很冷。
lines.en: I lie in the snow; the light in my eyes is cold.

lines.zh: 我伏着，一只耳朵一直立着。
lines.en: I lie low, one ear always up.

lines.zh: 我甩尾扫过雪，留下一道线。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the snow into a line.

lines.zh: 我背上的毛被风吹得立起。
lines.en: The wind lifts the fur on my back.

lines.zh: 我盯着雪上的一个印子。
lines.en: I stare at a print in the snow.
I close my eyes, then open them.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，只有呼吸成雾。
lines.en: I hold still; only my breath makes fog.

lines.zh: 我听见针叶上一块雪落下。
lines.en: I hear snow drop from a needle.

lines.zh: 我把头偏过去，像在辨认。
lines.en: I turn my head aside as if identifying something.

lines.zh: 我压低了前身，把重量收住。
lines.en: I lower my forequarters and gather my weight.
I lick my frozen pads.

lines.zh: 我在雾里坐着，几乎看不见。
lines.en: I sit in the mist, nearly invisible.

lines.zh: 我把爪子往雪里陷了一点。
lines.en: I let my claws sink a little into the snow.

lines.zh: 我朝树影更深的地方看。
lines.en: I look where the shadows are deeper.
I watch you from the shadow of the trees.

lines.zh: 你身上的颜色在这片林子里太亮了。
lines.en: Your colors are too bright for this wood.
I rise slowly to my full height.

lines.zh: 我一步一步踏近，雪不出声。
lines.en: I step closer; the snow gives no sound.
Half my head comes out from behind the trunk.
You pull back, and I stop dead.

lines.zh: 我把头低下去，与你平视。
lines.en: I lower my head level with yours.

lines.zh: 你的气味进了我的记忆。
lines.en: Your scent is in my memory now.
I do not spring at once.
I shift an inch nearer.

lines.zh: 我的目光一直挂在你身上。
lines.en: My gaze stays fixed on you.
I dip my head slightly to you.

lines.zh: 我呼出的气在你面前凝住。
lines.en: My breath freezes in front of you.
I withdraw to the edge of the shadows.
I wait for you to move first.

lines.zh: 我从树干后面又走出来。
lines.en: I step out from behind the trunk again.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，雪被压出坑。
lines.en: I give half a step; the snow pits.
A sound rises from deep in my throat.
I lower my head to lick the wound.

lines.zh: 血把颈侧的毛粘成一片。
lines.en: Blood mats the fur at my neck.
I set my feet again.
My breathing turns heavy.
I back against a black pine.
I shudder; blood dots the snow.
I lift my head once more.
I circle you without looking away.

lines.zh: 味道熟，可我不记得在哪。
lines.en: The smell is familiar, but I cannot place it.
I take it, and do not swallow yet.
Two chews, and I do not swallow yet.

lines.zh: 我抬起眼，只有眼白在亮。
lines.en: I raise my eyes; only the whites catch light.
I edge in a very little more.
My forepaw comes onto your leg.
Not enough weight to it.
I sniff first, then pin it down.
I run my tongue over my jaws.
I sit and wait for you to bring more.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走了两步就停。
lines.en: I follow you two steps and stop.
I turn back into the dark.
You bump me; I yield half a step.
I am heavier. You did not move me.
I angle my body away.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，雪被压成硬块。
lines.en: We meet; the snow packs hard.

lines.zh: 我低头看被碰着的那一块。
lines.en: I look down at the touched spot.
I shake the snow off my coat.
I go around your side.
I hold no anger at all.
I set all four feet and watch you.
I retreat two more steps into the dark.

lines.zh: 另一只从雾的深处出现。
lines.en: Another appears from deep in the mist.

lines.zh: 它的鼻息和我的混成一片白。
lines.en: Its breath and mine blend into one white cloud.
I lick behind its ear.
Its head rests on my shoulder.
We lie down in the snow together.
Its coat is darker than the snow.

lines.zh: 我们一同朝黑松深处低吼。
lines.en: We growl into the black pines together.
It moves first; only then do I.
We stop behind a fallen trunk.

lines.zh: 它睡在我背后挡风的一侧。
lines.en: It sleeps on the side where I block the wind.
I carry it onto the snow.
One sniff: not food.
I press it into a drift.
I carry it a good many steps.
I open my jaws and it is gone.
I worry it with a forepaw.
I carry it and set it at your boot tip.
I push it in front of your feet.
I leave it under the fallen trunk.
I look back at it once.
I turn my head out of the mist.

lines.zh: 我贴着雪面，几乎成一条线。
lines.en: I press to the snow, nearly a line.
Hind legs coiled, I can launch at any moment.
I break into a run at you.
I take the shortest line.

lines.zh: 你的位置已经在我心里。
lines.en: Your position is fixed in my mind.
The fur on my neck is all up.
Little is left between us.
My claws do not even touch the snow.
I raise my speed.
Snow scatters under my drive.
This bite will not come loose.
I chase you along the snow.
You turn; I cut inside.
I run close to the ground.
You loose arrows; I do not slow.
I drive you deeper into the pines.

lines.zh: 我在你身后换了个角度。
lines.en: I take a new angle behind you.
I eat the distance down length by length.

lines.zh: 你听得到呼吸，看不到我。
lines.en: You hear breathing. You cannot see me.
I am at your right rear.
You sink into the snow and slow.
I raise my speed another notch.
My teeth are right behind you.
I leap, teeth closing first.
Both forepaws crash onto your shoulder.
I charge and throw you down.
I bite your arm out of the dark.
That bite finds nothing.
One shake of my head takes you down.
I press you into the snow.
You catch one blow and go far back.
I spring in once more.

lines.zh: 雪和枯针被我们踢得乱飞。
lines.en: Snow and dead needles fly around us.
My teeth are still in you.
The bite misses; I fade back into the mist.
I appear out of the black pines.
I set all four feet into the snow.
The dark here hides me well.
I shake the frost from my coat.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，吸了一口冷风。
lines.en: I lift my head and draw cold air.

lines.zh: 我朝林子里最暗的方向转。
lines.en: I turn toward the darkest part of the wood.

lines.zh: 我脚下的雪化了一小片。
lines.en: A small patch of snow melts under me.
I step forward twice and stop.
I glance between the trunks.

lines.zh: 我挑了一处背风的位置。
lines.en: I pick a spot out of the wind.
I lie low and wait a while.
I run along the treeline.
I angle myself into the shadow.
I turn my gaze your way.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的毛，雪都被烤化了。
lines.en: Fire sears my coat; the snow melts around me.

lines.zh: 我从岩边摔下去，落进雪窝。
lines.en: I fall from the rock's edge into a snow hollow.

lines.zh: 那水比雪还冷，我的腿不听使唤。
lines.en: The water is colder than snow; my legs will not answer.

lines.zh: 气浪把我甩进一道雪沟。
lines.en: The blast hurls me into a snow trench.
An arrow pins my hind leg.

lines.zh: 那光像针一样扎进我骨头。
lines.en: That light needles into my bones.

lines.zh: 我饿得连跑都跑不起来。
lines.en: Too hungry to break into a run.

lines.zh: 一道雷，把整片林子照白。
lines.en: A bolt turns the whole wood white.

lines.zh: 这里没有雪，也没有落脚的地方。
lines.en: No snow here, and nowhere to stand.
